status: Interface specified and mechanically tested; no PHVS offer, buyer contact, transaction probability or bid price asserted.
default_meaning: No unverified takeover premium in standalone value, not a belief that acquisition is impossible.

buyer_economics.calculation: PV of product/geography cash flows under buyer execution minus necessary development/manufacturing/medical/commercial costs plus avoidable overhead saving minus integration and incumbent franchise cannibalization, all at the same date.
required_costs: Customer support, access and variable selling costs
buyer_economics.saving_limits: Only incremental avoidable expenses, with a phase-in. No elimination of all R&D or SG&A. Buying PHVS may reduce but not eliminate incumbent HAE sales losses; subtract a documented counterfactual lost profit.

negotiation.shareholder_price: Separate scenario within seller reservation and buyer economic ceiling. A chosen premium or share of net synergies is a bargaining assumption, not an observed bid.
negotiation.integration_payment: Acquirer integration costs reduce buyer economic value, not automatically shareholder cash consideration; distinguish payers.
negotiation.form: Cash default; stock consideration requires acquirer share price/exchange ratio and taxes only if specifically modeled. No invented CVR cash added atfacevalue.

timing.completed_before_target: Shareholder cash consideration carried to target at an explicit cash reinvestment rate, default0.
timing.completed_after_target: Outside default horizon. In a separate extended-horizon scenario discount consideration back to target; do not label it already received bytarget.
timing.announced_not_completed: At target show completion probability*discounted consideration + failure probability*standalone break value less costs. Announcement alone is not the completed-acquisition terminal state.

dependencies: Conditional on clinical state, commercial outcomes, buyer capacity and acceptable negotiated price.
Asset-only transaction probability is0 if bothprogramsfail; no universal generous bailout.
A buyer with HAE infrastructure may have larger savings and larger cannibalization; model both.
Strategic fit supports plausibility, not high empirical PHVS-specific probability.
No add-on acquisition premium in both productNPV and terminalbranch.

function_contract.buyer_value_interface: Inputs are after-tax PVs at transaction date; outputs buyer value and a negotiation scenario, not an executeddeal. Reject proposals above buyer ceiling.
function_contract.acquisition_outcome: Returns one target-date per-share payoff, never standalone+purchaseprice.

remaining_judgments: Acceptable-price bargaining share or explicit consideration scenario
